quotes.name: Adash Stanley
quotes.quote: The mood among fans is electric. I've felt the excitement building around the Oaks, it's like the whole city is waking up with the team. There's a buzz in the air, and I think people are really looking forward to seeing what they can do this season.

quotes.name: Trenton Nawan
quotes.quote: I'm still feeling pretty good about the Oaks. That 4-0 start has really got me hopeful. I checked the scores twice a day all week and was happy every time they won. Maybe they're finally getting their act together.

quotes.name: Trevor Henderson
quotes.quote: I've seen the energy around the Oaks lately, and it's electric. The crowd was locked-in during the NBA Cup opener against OKC, and you could feel the excitement. As a player, it's motivating to see the fans so engaged. We're on a two-game win streak, and the vibe is great.

claim: The mood among fans is electric. I've felt the excitement building around the Oaks, it's like the whole city is waking up with the team. There's a buzz in the air, and I think people are really looking forward to seeing what they can do this season.
